title: Independent practice
note: An independent practice working at the intersection of education, infrastructure, and public buildings. The studio reads each site — its topography, climate, and civic edges — before form is committed, then carries the design through a small kit of computational tools (Sketchup, Grasshopper, Rhino, Ladybug) until it has the precision to be built.
noteZh: 聚焦于教育建筑、基础设施与公共建筑的独立工作室。每个方案先读场地——它的等高线、它的气候、它的公共边界——再让形态从这里生发，经一套精炼的计算工具(Sketchup、Grasshopper、Rhino、Ladybug)推至落地。
